v1_5_changes: Added TL (Timelocked) — finality_permitted: [0] only. Corrected PD/CD finality_permitted to [0] per SEM-002/SEM-004.
Removed HL (Hold) — namespace collision with Action HL. Removed per §F-2.
Removed ER (Error) — validation outcome, not a persisted event state. Removed per §F-2.

entries.name: Final
entries.description: Event is final. FN+1 means settled and finality-locked; FN+0 means settled but subject to a protocol-level challenge or reversal window.

entries.name: Conditional
entries.description: Event is conditional on an external trigger or subsequent event

entries.name: Reversed
entries.description: Event has been reversed by a subsequent authority action

entries.name: Timelocked
entries.description: Event is time-locked pending expiry of a time-bound constraint (e.g., optimistic rollup challenge window, HTLC timeout). Finality MUST be 0 while the time lock is active.
